definitions.gloss: mountain valley; area among the mountains
definitions.explanation: The land between mountains: a narrow valley or a spot surrounded by mountains. Also written {山間|やまあい}.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}あい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}ち{込|こ}めている→立ち込める：31724_tachikomeru⟧。
examples.english: Mist hangs in the mountain valley.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}あい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧で、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: We spent a quiet weekend at a small hot-spring inn in a mountain valley.

notes:
Often written {山間|やまあい}; the same kanji read さんかん is a more formal word for mountainous areas (⟦{山間部|さんかんぶ}→山間部：31822_sankanbu⟧, used in weather forecasts).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山|やま}あい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧ / ⟦{集落|しゅうらく}→集落：19622_shuuraku⟧: a mountain village / hamlet
- {山|やま}あい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧: a river flowing between the mountains
- {山|やま}あい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧: a hot spring in the mountains

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{谷|たに}→谷：02223_tani⟧: valley — the low ground itself; {山|やま}あい is the whole setting among the mountains
